title: Allocating Indivisible Goods to Strategic Agents: Pure Nash Equilibria and Fairness
abstract: arXiv:2109.08644v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We consider the problem of fairly allocating a set of indivisible goods to a set of strategic agents with additive valuation functions. We assume no monetary transfers and, therefore, a mechanism in our setting is an algorithm that takes as input the reported -- rather than the true -- values of the agents. Our main goal is to explore whether there exist mechanisms that have pure Nash equilibria for every instance and, at the same time, provide fairness guarantees for the allocations that correspond to these equilibria. We focus on two relaxations of envy-freeness, namely envy-freeness up to one good (EF1), and envy-freeness up to any good (EFX), and we positively answer the above question. In particular, we study two algorithms that are known to produce such allocations in the non-strategic setting: Round-Robin (EF1 allocations for any number of agents) and a cut-and-choose algorithm of Plaut and Roughgarden [SIAM Journal of D

translated_title: 将不可分割物品分配给策略性代理人：纯纳什均衡与公平性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了将一组不可分割物品公平分配给一组具有可加估值函数的策略性代理人的问题。我们假设不存在货币转移，因此在我们所设定的框架中，机制是一种以代理人报告的（而非真实的）价值作为输入的算法。我们的主要目标是探索是否存在这样的机制：对于每一个实例都存在纯纳什均衡，同时又能为这些均衡所对应的分配提供公平性保证。我们关注无嫉妒性的两种松弛形式，即“消除单件物品后的无嫉妒性”（EF1）和“消除任意一件物品后的无嫉妒性”（EFX），并对上述问题给出了肯定的答案。特别地，我们研究了两种已知在非策略性设定下能够产生此类分配的算法：轮询算法（Round-Robin，可为任意数量的代理人产生EF1分配）以及Plaut和Roughgarden提出的切分-选择算法。
tldr: 本文证明了对每个实例都存在纯纳什均衡的公平分配机制（如轮询算法），且其均衡所对应的分配能够保证EF1/EFX公平性，从而肯定地回答了在无货币转移的策略性环境下能否实现公平分配的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that there exist mechanisms (such as Round-Robin) that possess pure Nash equilibria for every instance in the allocation of indivisible goods to strategic agents, and the allocations corresponding to these equilibria guarantee EF1/EFX fairness, positively answering whether fairness can be achieved in strategic settings without monetary transfers.
